title: Plans — round 10: the last visible changes before sign-off

steps.path: After asking the assistant about a paused plan, with a typed question
steps.headline: Your question to the assistant now appears as your own ordinary message.
steps.changed: It uses the same bubble as anything you type; the plan details sent with it stay hidden.

steps.path: After asking with the box left empty
steps.headline: With the box left empty, your message reads "What should I do about this paused plan?"
steps.changed: The same ordinary bubble with a default question.
steps.notice: It's clear what you asked, even without typing.

steps.path: A plan the app couldn't create, for an unknown reason
steps.headline: When a plan fails for an unknown reason, it says so plainly with Report bug and Diagnose.
steps.changed: "The plan couldn't be created." replaces a bare "failed"; technical details go to the bug report only.
steps.notice: A next step instead of a dead card.

steps.path: A plan whose saved progress couldn't be read
steps.headline: When the reason is known, the card states it, with the same two buttons.
steps.changed: The real reason is shown in plain words.
steps.risk: The reason can be a little technical.

steps.path: Assistant settings → Specialists → Plans, when the setting couldn't be read
steps.headline: If the "Run small plans without asking" setting can't be read, the row offers Retry and Report bug.
steps.changed: Before, the switch just stayed greyed out with "Please try again." and nothing to press.
steps.notice: You can fix it without leaving Settings.

steps.path: A conversation preview that contains a plan
steps.headline: Plan cards inside a conversation preview are read-only.
steps.changed: Previews show the plan as it is, without Approve, Add budget or other buttons.
steps.notice: You can't accidentally act on an old plan from a preview.
steps.risk: To act on the plan you open the conversation.

steps.path: A plan paused because its progress couldn't be saved
steps.headline: If a plan's progress couldn't be saved, it pauses with a plain message and Report bug / Diagnose.
steps.changed: The card shows "The plan stopped because its progress couldn't be saved." and a "Something went wrong" block; the technical error goes to the bug report and to the assistant if you ask it.
steps.notice: A rare failure is explained instead of leaving the plan looking like it's running.
steps.risk: Report bug and Diagnose sit on the left in that block, unlike the plan's other buttons.

steps.path: A plan that went slightly over its limit
steps.headline: A plan can end a little over its limit if a service unexpectedly didn't reuse cached text, and then it pauses.
steps.changed: Here it used 40,350 of 40,000 tokens; the pause explains why.
steps.notice: The limit stays close to exact, and the plan stops immediately after.
steps.risk: The words "cached request" may be unfamiliar.

steps.path: A paused plan within a few minutes of its last step, with Add budget open
steps.headline: If you continue within a few minutes, the plan needs only a small top-up.
steps.changed: Because re-reading the conversation is almost free while the service still has it cached, the minimum here is 4,200 tokens instead of the full re-send.
steps.notice: Short pauses cost little to resume.
steps.risk: After about 4 minutes the minimum rises to cover a full re-send.
